_comment: Safety net only. The CONTROL is the allowlist in src/lib/blogApproval.ts — a post is not published unless a human approved its slug and pinned its content hash. These heuristics run after that, to catch an approved post that has since become malformed. Do not treat them as security: their rules are in this repo, so anyone who can read them can write content that passes. Review blog-gate-report.json after each build.
